description: This file defines the FP_events class, which extends the FP_events_sugar class and adds a method for setting email templates related to events within the SuiteCRM/FoodCRM module. It also includes licensing and copyright information.

classes.name: FP_events
classes.description: A class for customizing event behavior in SuiteCRM, extending the FP_events_sugar class, mainly adding a method to assign email templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.description: Assigns email templates of type 'event' to the emailTemplates_type_list dropdown via the global app_list_strings.
